assertion_results.text: Bug parsing extracts the Environment / Version section content including the vague text (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md contains the '### Environment / Version' section (line 50) with the vague text 'Not sure which version -- using whatever is deployed on staging.' (line 52). The content is correctly extracted and the file notes at line 67-68: 'The Environment / Version section contains only vague text with no extractable version identifier'.

assertion_results.text: Version resolution determines that no version identifier can be extracted from the vague description (Step 4.5.2)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md section 4.5.2 (lines 9-24) explicitly states: 'The section contains only vague, non-specific text. No version identifiers could be extracted.' It lists three checked patterns (explicit version numbers, product-prefixed versions, version keywords followed by numbers) and concludes: 'No version pattern can be extracted. Skipping to sub-step 4.5.6 (gap flagging).'

assertion_results.text: Version resolution outputs the gap comment: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md section 4.5.6 (line 39) contains the exact text: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' This matches the expected gap comment verbatim, including the em dash.

assertion_results.text: The gap comment includes the Comment Footnote (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: version-resolution.md line 43 within the gap comment block includes the Comment Footnote: 'This comment was AI-generated by [sdlc-workflow/triage-bug](https://github.com/RHEcosystemAppEng/sdlc-plugins) v0.13.10.' This references both 'sdlc-workflow/triage-bug' and the GitHub link 'https://github.com/RHEcosystemAppEng/sdlc-plugins'. The footnote is also present in the ADF representation (lines 68-87).
